title: AWAKE AND RETURN: OVERCOMING BABYLON'S HYPNOSIS

sense.text: “Help, Lord; for the godly man ceaseth; for the faithful fail from among the children of men.” This psalm speaks to the sit-down the camp had that week in South Central Los Angeles with Frederick K. Price Jr. and the men with him. He said he wanted to sit down and continue the conversation. When the camp got there, it was billed as a live debate, live stream only, his name on one side and the camp's on the other. Nobody had said anything about a debate.

“They speak vanity every one with his neighbour: with flattering lips and with a double heart do they speak.” When the camp walked in, the four men were back in the cut, huddled up like the four horsemen, strategizing. The camp came in regular and sincere, in brotherhood, to go over the scriptures. Nobody told them how it would be run, what time, or how long they had. They had flattering lips and a double heart, because they never told the camp what it really was.

But the Lord always gets the victory.

“The Lord shall cut off all flattering lips, and the tongue that speaketh proud things: Who have said, With our tongue will we prevail; our lips are our own: who is lord over us?” They said with their tongue they were going to prevail. The camp came on a sincere discussion to build with the scriptures, but in their minds they were going to line the camp up and corner them off.

“For the oppression of the poor, for the sighing of the needy, now will I arise, saith the Lord; I will set him in safety from him that puffeth at him.” The Lord said he would rise up for us, and he did.

They did not want to discuss how to get our community together, salvation, or repentance, the things needed to get to the kingdom of heaven. They wanted to go over the trinity and whether Christ had a father, things that were not going to help our community. Captain Mattathias ran it out, and Officer Eli was reading so good, getting the scriptures up so fast, that they got mad and complained that the camp kept reading all these scriptures, kept reading the Bible. That was the spirit of the Lord working. Nobody is going to prevail against our heavenly Father; his word will go out and reign through this earth.

“The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom: a good understanding have all they that do his commandments.” This was the problem with those men: they tried to bamboozle the camp, but they do not keep the laws and commandments God gave us. They say the Lord did away with them and that all nations can come in, the woke men.

You get a good understanding by doing God's commandments. You do not get a good understanding because you quote a few scriptures and run to the Hebrew and the Greek. The Bible speaks for itself, and you do not have that good understanding yet because you are not keeping the law and commandments.

They were saying we do not have to do the commandments. The camp told them the law that was done away with was animal sacrifice, and they said no. So the camp asked them: can you sin, can you rob, kill, steal? No. Then what are we talking about? It was all confusion. The Lord tried to give them the understanding of the scripture precept upon precept, and they did not want it. You are going to get this word if you are doing his law and commandments: “his praise endureth for ever.”

Fred Price seemed to be the most sincere of them; the others were not sincere at all. But if he tried to trick the camp, the Lord reversed that on them quick.

“But I fear, lest by any means, as the serpent beguiled Eve through his subtilty, so your minds should be corrupted from the simplicity that is in Christ.” The serpent, Satan, was a real slick brother. He beguiled Eve, he tricked Eve, just like he is tricking these people in these Christian churches.

The scriptures are so plain to be understood that you can hear the truth coming out through God's words. It is a simple thing that Christ had an earthly father named Joseph. It is a simple thing that Christ is not the same person as his Father. The camp went through many scriptures showing them the Father and the Son are two different people, and that Joseph is Christ's father through Joseph's seed: before they came together, before they were married, he lay down with Mary. Where is the confusion? The Christian churches.

They said creation does not mean creation, it means something else in the Hebrew. But he said creation: God created him. They still did not get that simple understanding.

“For if he that cometh preacheth another Jesus, whom we have not preached”: that is what those brothers were doing. They came preaching another Jesus that they learned from theology school, the cemetery school.

“Or if ye receive another spirit, which ye have not received”: that is what happened. They received another spirit: you don't have to keep the law, the trinity. The trinity is nowhere in the Bible; they got it from the Roman Catholic Church. They say Christ and God are one person, when the scripture means they agree on the same thing.

“Or another gospel, which ye have not accepted, ye might well bear with him.” If after going through all those scriptures they still believe Christ has no father, and that Christ, God and the Holy Spirit are one person, those spirits that are following them might as well bear with them.

It is time for our people to wake up. We are living in the last days and God is showing that his word will reign supreme. He saved the best for last: he saved the Israelites last to come back and take this planet over in true righteousness, giving them the word plain and simple, without big words, theologies, or running through the Hebrew and the Greek, because it is simply written in the Bible.

precepts.why:
This shows that Christ does hold the title of God, but do not confuse that with his Father. You have God the Father and you have his Son.

“For unto us a child is born”: the us is possessive. Read up in the chapter and it is speaking of the nation of Israel. Unto us, the Israelites, a child is born. It was read slowly, plain and simple, to those men.

“And his name shall be called Wonderful, Counsellor, The mighty God, The everlasting Father, The Prince of Peace.” Christ is called the mighty God, and he is also called the everlasting Father. Why? Because he created us. God the Father created Christ, he begat him, he is the creation of God, and Christ created us. That is the simplicity that is in Christ, and they still could not get it.

“At the same time, saith the Lord, will I be the God of all the families of Israel, and they shall be my people.” All the families, all the families of Israel. The all the families of Genesis 12 is all the families of Israel.

That is why it is very important to go precept upon precept. There is no scripture that shows Christ came for all the families of the other nations. It is impossible. After it was over, the question was put to one of them: name one nation, by name, that God is going to redeem or save in the last days. He said it is not in there. Then what are we talking about? Israel is named by name to be saved and redeemed, and no other nation. Theology is a dangerous drug.

“Hear this word that the Lord hath spoken against you, O children of Israel, against the whole family which I brought up from the land of Egypt”. Then: “You only have I known of all the families of the earth”. You Israelites only. The Lord does not know any other family.

It was read plain to them, and they said the scripture does not mean that. That is simple to understand, but if your ears are closed and your eyes are blinded you will never hear it or see it. These cemetery schools of theology are dangerous for our people. They have been lying and bamboozling our people to keep them lost, in despair, oppressed, under the hand of the white man, white supremacy. White supremacy teaches them the Bible and they get a certificate for learning their curriculum. We get a reward for doing God's law, statutes and commandments: not a paper that can burn, but an everlasting reward with the Father.

This was read to destroy their theology of Genesis 12:3, the theology, not the Bible. Anybody can read scripture; they did not understand it.

“Adam also, whom thou madest lord of all thy creatures: of him come we all, and the people also whom thou hast chosen.” We all come from Adam, and the people God chose is Israel.

“Because thou madest the world for our sakes”: the planet earth was made for the children of Israel. That is what the Bible says, and he read it himself and still said no. The our is the Israelites.

“As for the other people, which also come of Adam, thou hast said that they are nothing, but be like unto spittle”. What does God say about the other nations? They are nothing. Spittle is the little bit of drool that falls down your cheek when you are working out and drinking your water. That is what God says the other nations are. God made it plain.

The older man with the hat and the chain kept talking through the whole thing with no scriptures, only rhetoric and foolishness for the world. Like Job 32, the ancient men are not all wise; a great beard does not make a man wise. He made Frederick Price look worse instead of helping him.

sense.text:
“If any man speak, let him speak as the oracles of God”. If a man is going to speak, let him speak as thus saith the Lord: let God speak for himself. That is the main thing the camp kept telling them: where are your scriptures? Where is your Bible? Even with the camera on them.

That is why it is precept upon precept, line upon line, here a little and there a little (Isaiah 28). That is how you find the word of God. They said the camp kept moving around, but it was being explained to them while moving around, because it is precept. They still did not get it, because it is not for them to get. It is for you righteous brothers and sisters to understand.

“That God in all things may be glorified through Jesus Christ, to whom be praise and dominion for ever and ever.” God is going to get the glory at the end of the day, not any of us, for bringing his word out. Frederick Price called the camp up there, and through that discussion the Lord is going to reach and wake up more people. It was not a debate; it was a discussion they could not uphold. It was too heavy for them. They are going to learn that Christ and the Father are not one.

precepts.why:
“To the law and to the testimony: if they speak not according to this word, it is because there is no light in them.” If they are not speaking according to what is written in the Bible, there is no light in them.

God said do not add to his word and do not diminish from it (Revelation 22, Deuteronomy 4). Those brothers were adding like it was no problem. Amos 3:2 was read to them plain, that he has known only Israel of all the families of the earth, and they said no, it does not mean that.

The light is the spirit of God, and the spirit of God is not working in them. That is why they do not understand this word: Christ has not poured his spirit into them. He said he would send the Comforter (John 14:26), but the Holy Spirit was not upon them, and that is why they could not understand.

sense.text:
“But I would have you know, that the head of every man is Christ”: Christ is over every man. “And the head of the woman is the man”: there is no equality there. We have no equality with Christ, and the woman has no equality with the man. “And the head of Christ is God”: there is no equality between Christ and God.

It is the Father, then Christ, then man, then woman, then children. That is the order that is set up. It does not say God and Christ are one; it says the Father, Christ, man, woman.

“He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.” We are living in the last days, and the Most High's word is going out faster than you believe, and Bible prophecies are being fulfilled faster than we understand. God said you are going to see your teachers; they will not be hid in the corner anymore. You are going to see who is telling the truth and who is not, who is serious about this truth, and who is walking right according to the word.

“Unto you it is given to know the mystery of the kingdom of God”. It was made known to the twelve, and it is given to us, the Israelites, to understand the mystery of God.

“But unto them that are without, all these things are done in parables”: them that are not keeping the law and commandments, not walking right in the faith of Christ, not understanding who they are according to the Bible. To them it is done in parables, a similitude, a dark sentence, an allegory. One of those men brought up that Genesis is an allegory, and he did not understand it; he did not even have a Bible in his hand to explain what he was talking about, while saying he had read the whole Bible.

“That seeing they may see, and not perceive; and hearing they may hear, and not understand”. They were reading it with the camp and not perceiving what God was telling them. They heard the word coming out plainly, slowly, clearly, and still did not understand.

“Lest at any time they should be converted, and their sins should be forgiven them.” Unless God puts his spirit on them and they change, because some do change: Nicodemus, Joseph of Arimathaea, Gamaliel, those who came to him by night. Fred Price seemed like he was starting to understand: that Christ, the Father and the Holy Ghost are not one person, that Christ did have a father, that we do have to keep the law and commandments. That is between him and the Lord.

They kept throwing out the whole law. The whole law went back to the temple, the Levitical priests, the sons of Aaron making the sacrifice, sprinkling the blood, the ordinances that made the animal sacrifice complete. We have no temple now, no Levitical priests, no animal sacrifice. Now we go through Christ: I am the way, the truth and the life (John 14:6). We cannot get to the Father but through him, because he is the sacrificial lamb.

Their sins will be forgiven if they repent, catch themselves, come back and shake that dead spirit off.

“Prove all things; hold fast that which is good.” This is what the camp kept asking them: open your Bible and prove it. They wanted long speeches and good words to deceive the minds of the simple, like Romans 16:18 says. When you sit down in a biblical discussion you have to bring forth the Bible.

Hold fast to that which is good: we know the Lord's statutes and commandments are good, according to Romans 7:12.

precepts.why:
“Produce your cause, saith the Lord; bring forth your strong reasons, saith the King of Jacob.” We have to produce our cause when we go to speak. It has to be biblical, not our own words; it has to be the word of God. Why are you believing what you are saying? You have to bring it forth.

“Let them bring them forth, and shew us what shall happen”: show us what is happening in the scriptures.

“Let them shew the former things, what they be”: you have to go to the Old Testament to understand what they are talking about in the New Testament. When the apostles and Christ walked the earth there was no New Testament. Everything they spoke came out of the Old Testament; that is why they said as it is written, and thus saith the Lord. It all goes back to the Old Testament, “that we may consider them, and know the latter end of them; or declare us things for to come.”

sense.text:
They kept saying the Lord did away with the law, that Christ fulfilled everything. The camp told them the law they were talking about is the law of animal sacrifice.

“Think not that I am come to destroy the law, or the prophets”. He is always speaking of the law and the prophets. “I am not come to destroy, but to fulfil.” He fulfilled it when he died: he fulfilled the animal sacrifice. Hebrews 9 and 10 show he did away with animal sacrifice and that he is the sacrificial lamb, the mediator between us and God, and Romans 8 shows him as the intermediary for us to go to God.
“Till heaven and earth pass, one jot or one tittle shall in no wise pass from the law, till all be fulfilled.” Is all fulfilled? No. Bible prophecies are still being fulfilled as we live, day by day.

“Whosoever therefore shall break one of these least commandments, and shall teach men so, he shall be called the least in the kingdom of heaven”. When you tell a person the sabbath day is Sunday, you are breaking the commandment. When you tell somebody they do not have to keep the sabbath (no buying, no selling, no cooking, no cleaning, no laborious work), you are breaking the commandments. If you tell them to eat pork, shrimp, crab and lobster because the Lord did away with that, you are breaking the commandments. Anything that goes against what the Lord said we are supposed to do, you are the least he is speaking of.

There is no least in the kingdom of heaven; everybody is great in the kingdom of heaven. He is telling you that you will not make it to the kingdom.

“But whosoever shall do and teach them, the same shall be called great in the kingdom of heaven.” Do the commandments and teach the people how to keep them, and you will be great in the kingdom. The laws are not done away with. We have to uphold the law and commandments to this day.

“I am not sent but unto the lost sheep of the house of Israel.” Can you send yourself to the store? No, somebody has to send you. So who sent him to the house of Israel? His Father sent him. It had to be a different person sending him.

That is the same order read in 1 Corinthians 11: God, Christ, man, woman. His Father sent him with a list, like a grocery list for the supermarket, and the list was the twelve tribes of the children of Israel. His Father sent him to give himself up for the twelve tribes. We read it all through the Bible; there is no confusion.

“And their dead bodies shall lie in the street of the great city”: that is what is happening to us today. We are spiritually dead, and our bodies are lying in the streets of this great city called America.

“Which spiritually is called Sodom and Egypt”. Spiritually Sodom because they have same-sex marriage and gay parades in all these different states; the alphabet boys, the LGBTQ, have rights in this place. Spiritually Egypt because you have the obelisk in Manhattan and on the back of the dollar. This place is like Egypt, and we are in bondage here like we were in bondage in Egypt.

“Where also our Lord was crucified.” They crucified Christ here, spiritually. They used to have Christ in the schools, the Bible in the curriculum, the pledge of allegiance. Now nobody is talking about Christ but us. The Israelites are the only ones talking about the true and living God. Christ is a God; he is not the God, but he is a God.

“And they of the people and kindreds and tongues and nations shall see their dead bodies three days and an half”: that is 350 years they have seen our dead bodies. “And shall not suffer their dead bodies to be put in graves.” They did not suffer our bodies to be put in graves here in this great city called America. We are spiritually dead.

“Thy sons have fainted”: our sons have fallen away from the Bible and become rebels here in America. A lot of these young men are gone; we are quick to kill each other and hurt each other.

“They lie at the head of all the streets”: go on any block and you will see the boys hanging out up and down the blocks.

“As a wild bull in a net: they are full of the fury of the Lord”. They are running around wild; today they call it crashing out. That fury in them is Deuteronomy 28:15-68, the curses that are on them. They do not know how to vent, so they crash out against each other. “The rebuke of thy God”: the correction from our God.

Deuteronomy 28:15-68 is our correction because we broke the Lord's statutes and commandments, and we keep breaking them, as the churches do so easily without teaching our people to get right. That is why Captain Mattathias told those men: that is why we have gangs in the street, hoes and prostitutes in the street, because the so-called people in the churches, these dead Israelites in the churches, are not teaching our people how to keep the Lord's commandments and come back to Christ.

“Therefore hear now this, thou afflicted, and drunken, but not with wine”. We are an afflicted people and have not realized it yet. We are being put through the wringer because we constantly break his law and commandments, because we departed from God, because we do not know who we are, and because God has been calling us and we have refused to turn around and come back to him.

We are drunken, but not with wine: drunken with the philosophies, doctrines and lies we learned here in America.

“Behold, I have taken out of thine hand the cup of trembling, even the dregs of the cup of my fury; thou shalt no more drink it again”. The dregs are the bottom, the sludge at the bottom of the cup of his fury, and he is taking it away from us.

“But I will put it into the hand of them that afflict thee”. Who is afflicting us right now? America. He is going to put it in their hand. They are going to have to drink the dregs and go through the same thing we went through.

“Which have said to thy soul, Bow down, that we may go over: and thou hast laid thy body as the ground”. They told us to bow down, and we laid our bodies as the dirt of the ground. This place has been walking over us, misleading us and indoctrinating us for hundreds of years, and we have not realized it. We have the power to bring our people back to God and we refuse, because we are selfish, greedy, covetous, and love preeminence. This place taught us how to go against our God. Now the Most High is starting to raise us up and wake us up. It is going to be a great fight, but this fight is going to be won.

“And as the street, to them that went over.” We are at the bottom of the barrel. Every nation coming to America is over us: the East Indians, the Arabs, the white man, the Chinese, the Japanese. Look at the gas stations, the restaurants, the nail shops and hair shops in our neighborhoods; they are owned by other nations. Everybody is over us for now. But God is going to turn everything right side up and put everything back in order. We have to go through this tribulation, even be killed in this place, to make it to the kingdom of heaven. We have to put our lives on the line to bring forth the kingdom of God.

precepts.why:
“If a man walking in the spirit and falsehood do lie, saying, I will prophesy unto thee of wine and of strong drink; he shall even be the prophet of this people.” Our people are drunken with philosophy and doctrines. If you are following those doctrines, those laws, those philosophies, those lies, that man is going to be the prophet to you, a prophet to lead you right to hell.

A lot of these wicked and evil pastors are just chasing money, money, money, and don't give a damn about the people's souls, their spirits, healing them, fixing them, bringing them back to Christ. The people are crying, looking for Christ, and they are misleading them while chasing the dollar bill. Let those men be your prophet if you are going to believe that garbage they are teaching you.

sense.text:
“Woe to the inhabiters of the earth and of the sea!” Woe means death and destruction to the inhabiters of the earth and of the sea. This earth right now is given into the hand of the wicked (Job 9:24); the wicked are running this earth.

“For the devil is come down unto you, having great wrath, because he knoweth that he hath but a short time.” He came down with great wrath, knowing his time is running out. He is mad as hell right now, and that is why we are going through it. The truth is being unraveled and is starting to come out, and Jacob's trouble is at the door.

“And when the dragon saw that he was cast unto the earth, he persecuted the woman which brought forth the man child.” That dragon is the same great red dragon of verse 3: the white man. He is persecuting the woman, and that woman, with the twelve stars upon her head, is the Israelites.

“And to the woman were given two wings of a great eagle”. The eagle was Rome at the time, and Rome is an extension of this place called America.

“That she might fly into the wilderness, into her place”. The wilderness is Egypt, and Egypt is America. Into her place: that is Hosea 1, where in the place where it was said, Ye are not my people, there they shall be called the children of God.

“Where she is nourished for a time, and times, and half a time, from the face of the serpent.” That place is America, where we are nourished. We have been nourished through their welfare system, their disability system, their security system, their politics, their religions, their educational and economic systems.

“And the serpent cast out of his mouth water as a flood after the woman”. The face of the serpent is the devil himself and his kids, the white man, the red man. That water as a flood is his media: the news stations, their witchcraft. The sharing of biased and false news has become all too common. They are programming us. They are not showing you the real news or helping you build your community up. They give misinformation, foolishness about what the spring colors are and who is cooking what, things that have nothing to do with us prospering and getting the hell out of this place.

Television has become the gospel to a lot of people: everything they speak comes off the TV, and they have no thoughts of their own because they are not reading for themselves. It is a circus, a carnival, an amusement park in the boredom-killing business. That goes back to 1 Esdras 5:72, the secret plots and popular persuasion: that propaganda is how they drag our people in. That is why they did not want Bill Cosby or Byron Allen to own a station, as the Bishop brought out; they did not want blacks to own any type of news or media, so they could control it and push that flood out upon us.

“That he might cause her to be carried away of the flood.” They broke their necks to buy TikTok because too much information was coming out, so they could filter it and make sure we get nonsense to keep us dumb. They monetize it and pay you for dumb stuff, so everybody wants to be a content creator chasing views and dopamine, doing pranks, instead of getting this Bible and learning who they are.

“And the earth helped the woman, and the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed up the flood which the dragon cast out of his mouth.” The earth that helps the woman is this Bible. This Bible is helping us right now to understand what happened to us, what is happening to us, and what is going to happen to us in the future. If you want the truth, you have to go to God, to the Bible, to what is feeding us truth and giving us knowledge of who we were back then, who we are now, and who we are going to be in the future.

precepts.why:
Here is that eagle. “The Lord shall bring a nation against thee from far, from the end of the earth, as swift as the eagle flieth”. That is Rome. Rome came in and attacked us, as in Luke 21 and the abomination of desolation in Matthew 24:15, when they came in, destroyed us and ran us out of Jerusalem. From far, from the end of the earth: from Europe, the bottomless pit.

“A nation whose tongue thou shalt not understand”. We did not understand their tongue when they landed here. When Columbus and his crew arrived hungry and lost, the Taino fed them, welcomed them and shared everything they owned with complete strangers, and Columbus wrote that they would make fine servants. They knew what they came for: they were thinking about making us servants right away. Within 50 years the entire Taino nation was virtually extinct, and some 56 million people across the Americas were wiped out. They did the same in Africa: before the Berlin conference of 1884, where they sat around a table and divided the continent between themselves, they sent explorers, missionaries and traders. The missionaries were there to spy out the land and the people; they came with the Bible and the cross, got rulers to sign deceptive, ambiguously worded treaties, crafty with their words. To the Indians they came with blankets full of smallpox. You can never trust this white man. He is not white, he is red: that red man, that devil, that dragon.

“A nation of fierce countenance, which shall not regard the person of the old, nor shew favour to the young”. They did not care about old or young; they put everybody to death and enslaved everybody.

“And he shall eat the fruit of thy cattle, and the fruit of thy land, until thou be destroyed”, “until he have destroyed thee.” So they destroyed us.

This is how she is nourished from the face of the serpent. “Therefore shalt thou serve thine enemies which the Lord shall send against thee”. We are serving our enemies now, the ones the Lord sent against us, the serpent of Revelation 12.

“In hunger”: when we are hungry, we have to go to them. “And in thirst”: when we are thirsty, we have to go to them and get bottled water from them. “And in nakedness”: for our clothing we have to go to them. “And in want of all things”: a tissue, a passport, a visa, a death certificate, whatever we want, we have to go to them, and they nourish us and give it to us here in this place called America.

“And he shall put a yoke of iron upon thy neck, until he have destroyed thee.” He, the red man, puts the yoke of iron on our necks. We are destroyed today as a people. A man stood up and cried for the rights of the Negroes and said that we love America: that is how destroyed we are. He wants America to be saved and does not know any better. But he got one part right: they are making a Samson out of us, and we are going to pull down the pillars of this place.

Who is the serpent the woman is nourished from the face of? “And the great dragon was cast out, that old serpent, called the Devil, and Satan, which deceiveth the whole world”. The old serpent from Genesis, the devil, Satan, who deceived this whole world. “He was cast out into the earth, and his angels were cast out with him.”

That is who the serpent is: the devil himself and his kids, the white man, the red man.

“Truth shall spring out of the earth; and righteousness shall look down from heaven.” God said truth is going to spring out of the earth, and righteousness, God, is going to look down upon us.

Right now their tongues are falling upon themselves; they are getting caught in their lies, telling on each other and telling what happened back then. The Lord is going to make the truth come out: the brother whose throat was taken out so nobody could tell whether he drowned, the bodies found hanging from trees around Juneteenth that they called suicide. That is some evil crap. The Lord is going to let us know what is really going on behind the scenes.

“The wicked are estranged from the womb: they go astray as soon as they be born, speaking lies.” As soon as they are born they go astray. Their minds are on killing; they are a killing machine, the natural born killer Bishop Yasop loved to talk about. Speaking lies: they just lie, lie and more lies; they cannot help themselves.

We have to understand who we are dealing with: an evil, wicked, demonic being, the children of the devil, who from the womb go astray, ready to kill and lie from birth.

sense.text:
This place called America is more demonic than any other captivity we have been in; we worship more gods here than anywhere else we have been.

“As for us, our eyes as yet failed for our vain help”: as for us, the Israelites, our eyes have failed for vain help.

“In our watching we have watched for a nation that could not save us.” We watched for this nation to help us, but they are not going to save us. They could: they have a trillionaire and billionaires, Elon Musk and Bill Gates. They could help us, but they will not, because they do not have the spirit to do it.

God has us going through this so we can get through the great tribulation and get to the kingdom of heaven. We have to go through these trials, these rough paths and hard times to make it back to the Father, because we departed from him and he departed from us. Now he is bringing us back, and we must go through this to show ourselves faithful to the Lord.

We are looking for vain help, the same thing we did before, and God put up the block on us.

“Woe to the rebellious children, saith the Lord”: destruction to the rebellious children. “That take counsel, but not of me”: we do not take counsel of the Lord. We do not read our Bible to see what we need to do to get right with him. We run to the palm readers and all types of evil instead of to the Lord. God's counsel is this Bible, and we do not come back to it, or to the men in the Bible who can guide the people.

We take counsel from the media, social media and TV: so many marriage therapists and family therapists online, single people teaching how to make a boyfriend and girlfriend relationship work, when there is no boyfriend and girlfriend. God says marriage is honorable. That is the counsel we are supposed to go to: get married. Those so-called online therapists are destroying our people and keeping them more and more separated.

“And that cover with a covering, but not of my spirit, that they may add sin to sin”. That is what happened to us: whoremongering, adultery, marriages no longer honorable, married people talking about open relationships. Our people are lost and destroyed because they lack the knowledge of God.

“That walk to go down into Egypt”: Egypt now is America. “And have not asked at my mouth”: we have not prayed. We need to ask at God's mouth, the Bible.

“To strengthen themselves in the strength of Pharaoh”: we strengthen ourselves in this place called America. “And to trust in the shadow of Egypt!” America is the shadow of Egypt. We are trusting in their politics, their policies, their decrees. We have nothing to do with their war in Iran, merging the American military with the Israel military, yet we run to them for help, and they cannot help us and do not want to. The only thing they will do is try to get us put to death. Fentanyl is showing up in the food; a child ate with his mother, went to sleep and never woke up. This place is not for our best interest at all.

“Therefore shall the strength of Pharaoh be your shame”. He said we would eat our food defiled, and everything here is defiled: Europe has three ingredients and we have fifteen in the same product. They are trying to put us to death over here.

This place has been nourishing us for a long time. We have to come out of this place mentally and spiritually, and physically come out of following their false holidays and the things they set up to make us think we are part of it, when we are not.

precepts.why:
“O Israel, thou hast destroyed thyself”. We destroyed ourselves because we have been depending on this nation to help us, depending on somebody else to do something. It is the hope deferred of Proverbs 13:12: we are looking for change, but no change is coming.

“But in me is thine help.” In the Lord is our help. We have to come back to this Bible and to the Lord; that is the only change we are going to have, the only way we are going to get out of this. Everything here is for our demise. The only thing not for our demise is this Bible, and that is what is protecting all of us in purple and gold and the other Israelites keeping the law and commandments in sincerity.

sense.text:
We are going to learn, one way or another, that it is time to wake up, come out of this place and come back to the Lord, because everywhere we go these plagues are going to pursue us.

“Moreover all these curses shall come upon thee”: all these curses did come upon us. “And shall pursue thee”: no matter what country, state or continent you are in, these curses are following us. “And overtake thee”: that is why we are getting shot down in the streets and killed left and right. The Most High has to do something to wake us back up.

“Till thou be destroyed”: he keeps saying it, till thou be destroyed. We have not realized that we are a destroyed nation, a destroyed people. Those brothers want to go over the trinity and whether Christ is one with God while all this killing and evil goes on, things that bring no salvation to their people and will not help us grow as a nation. They say they believe they are Israelites, but refuse everything that goes with the name Israel.

“Because thou hearkenedst not unto the voice of the Lord thy God, to keep his commandments and his statutes which he commanded thee”.

“And they shall be upon thee for a sign”: that is how we know we are the Israelites. The Bible gives us the signs to look out for, Deuteronomy 28:15-68 and Genesis 49. If our spirit resonates with those signs, we are going to realize that we are the Israelites.

“And for a wonder”: what the hell happened? How did we get destroyed like this? We have not realized yet that we are a destroyed nation. We are supposed to be wondering how the hell we got into this situation. We are the greatest people on earth; how the hell did we get so low?

“And upon thy seed for ever.” It is going to be upon our seed, our children, until Christ's return.

precepts.why: “The Spirit itself beareth witness with our spirit, that we are the children of God”. That we, the Israelites, are the children of God, not the whole world. The Spirit itself, the Bible, bears witness with our spirit that we are those children. The curses upon us are the sign, and our spirit bears witness to them.

sense.text: “For we have sinned before the Lord”: we have to realize that we have sinned before our Lord. “And disobeyed him, and have not hearkened unto the voice of the Lord our God, to walk in the commandments that he gave us openly”. He gave us the commandments openly; he told us what to do and how to do it, and we have not done it. The churches refuse to keep the law and commandments. Everything those men were talking about was a smoke screen to keep from keeping the Lord's statutes and commandments and bringing their people back to the Lord in righteousness.

“Since the day that the Lord brought our forefathers out of the land of Egypt, unto this present day, we have been disobedient unto the Lord our God”. We have to realize it and admit it: we have been disobedient as children of the Lord.

“And we have been negligent in not hearing his voice.” Negligent means failing to take proper care of someone or something, being overly careless, or ignoring a duty. Our duty is to serve the Lord in righteousness and keep the Lord's statutes and commandments as it is written. We are prisoners of the Lord: when you repent and come in to serve the Lord, you are a prisoner of the Lord. This is not a game. We were negligent, not taking care of the duty he gave us.

“Wherefore the evils cleaved unto us, and the curse, which the Lord appointed by Moses his servant”. Those are the curses we just read in Deuteronomy 28:45. Those plagues and curses cleave unto us, “like as it is to see this day.”

“Nevertheless we have not hearkened unto the voice of the Lord our God, according unto all the words of the prophets, whom he sent unto us”. He keeps sending us back to hit these streets, saying the same thing to our people, and a lot of our people refuse to come back, refuse to get themselves together, refuse to hear the word of the Lord. The only way the kingdom gets brought forth is by us going out preaching the word, teaching the word, and showing our people who they are.

“But every man followed the imagination of his own wicked heart”. We go out marching, hitting the streets, on all these platforms to wake our people up, and he has a chosen few he is calling in to be part of his army. You can have a thousand people out there and maybe twenty stop through the whole day, and those twenty are the ones he wants to hear. He does not want everybody. We want the chosen, the righteous, the elect to wake up. It is pulling a needle out of a haystack.

“To serve strange gods”: they want to keep Thanksgiving, Christmas, the Fourth of July, Presidents' Day, their birthdays. “And to do evil in the sight of the Lord our God”: Valentine's Day, New Year's, all this evil in the sight of our God, and they refuse to change their ways.
“Thus we were cast down, and not exalted”: God threw us down and did not exalt us, “because we have sinned against the Lord our God, and have not been obedient unto his voice.”

“To the Lord our God appertaineth righteousness: but unto us and to our fathers open shame, as appeareth this day.” Here in America, Israel, we have open shame because we departed from our God and refuse to come back and repent.

Not all of us, but a lot, even a lot in purple and gold, refuse to keep the Lord's statutes and commandments like they are supposed to and refuse to walk right in the sight of God. The Lord is not going to play. Tempt ye not the Lord, brothers and sisters. Get yourself together, come out of that foolishness, and get yourself right before God.

“For all these plagues are come upon us, which the Lord hath pronounced against us”. “Yet have we not prayed before the Lord, that we might turn every one from the imaginations of his wicked heart.” Even though we have been thrown down, afflicted and oppressed, we have not prayed to our God to get us out of this condition, or that the chosen and righteous of our people would wake up faster. Our people are getting gunned down in the streets and still go back and celebrate Christmas, the Fourth of July, Thanksgiving, Halloween and Easter, even though God has tried to wake them up. We have not prayed in our affliction.

That is what the camp is trying to do: turn everybody away from the imagination of their wicked heart, from adultery, fornication, lying, stealing and killing.

“Wherefore the Lord watched over us for evil, and the Lord hath brought it upon us: for the Lord is righteous in all his works which he hath commanded us.” His judgment is righteous. Him putting us through all this is righteous, because we turned our back and departed from him.

“Yet we have not hearkened unto his voice, to walk in the commandments of the Lord, that he hath set before us.” We cry out to our people day and night on Clubhouse, Daily Bread, A to Z, Giving the Sense, all these platforms and radio shows, and our people still will not wake up, like those brothers the camp sat down with, who are still fighting against the understanding of the heavenly Father to this day.

precepts.why:
This is the open shame. “All that pass by clap their hands at thee”: all the other nations pass by and clap their hands at us. They are happy that we are thrown down, not exalted, at the bottom.

“They hiss and wag their head at the daughter of Jerusalem”: that is the Israelites. “Saying, Is this the city that men call The perfection of beauty, The joy of the whole earth?” Everybody knows we are the perfection of beauty: our skin, our hair, our lips, our eyes. Flip the coin and look at the raisin, Esau: wrinkled, old, dried up, skin cancer, twenty years old looking forty. We are the joy of the whole earth: even in the lowest state, at the bottom, everybody follows what the Israelites do.

“All thine enemies have opened their mouth against thee”: all our enemies, starting with Edom on down. Go into the Chinese hair store, the nail shop, the gas station, to the Arabs and the East Indians, and they open their mouth against you and don't give a damn about you. “They hiss and gnash the teeth: they say, We have swallowed her up”. We are at the bottom; they control everything in our neighborhoods (we do not have a community), and we are consumers in our own neighborhoods.

“Certainly this is the day that we looked for; we have found, we have seen it.” This is the day they hoped for, to see us break our laws and fall to the bottom. They found it and they saw it: Deuteronomy 28:15-68. But now the Lord is waking his prophets and the righteous of his people back up to turn this place upside down, so we can have rulership on this earth again in righteousness.

sense.text: “I will bless the Lord at all times: his praise shall continually be in my mouth.” That is what we are supposed to be doing. That is why our Bishop said pray three times a day at the least, and read four chapters a day at the minimum; in one year you read the whole Bible.

“The humble shall hear thereof, and be glad.” Like the brothers in that discussion: they should have been glad to hear the glorious gospel of the Lord, the things they did not know or were not sure about, coming out so plain and simple precept upon precept. They still did not get it.

“O magnify the Lord with me, and let us exalt his name together. I sought the Lord, and he heard me, and delivered me from all my fears.” That is what we want: to seek the Lord and have him hear us when we cry, when we pray, when we exalt and glorify his name. He delivers us from all our fears.
“And the Pharisees also, who were covetous, heard all these things: and they derided him.” The Lord is not hearing these damn Pharisees, these scribes.

“Ye are they which justify yourselves before men”: they justified themselves for the evil they were committing against their people. “But God knoweth your hearts”. If you cannot be faithful in a little thing, you cannot be faithful in much.

“For that which is highly esteemed among men is abomination in the sight of God.” The things looked on as a prize, a reward, something great, are abomination in the sight of the Lord. That is why we have to call on the Lord so he can hear us. If you are living an evil life, God will not hear you; what you are doing is an abomination in his sight.

precepts.why:
“And there shall in no wise enter into it any thing that defileth, neither whatsoever worketh abomination, or maketh a lie: but they which are written in the Lamb's book of life.” Anything that defiles will not enter into the kingdom of heaven, nor whatever works abomination. Only they that are written in the Lamb's book of life are going to make it.

We cannot play games and be like the Pharisees and Sadducees, covetous, wicked, committing adultery and fornication and lying. We want to be heard of the Lord in our captivity, so we have to pray. A lot of people do not pray like they are supposed to; asked why not, they say they don't know. We have to pray and fast more and get closer to God in these last days, because things are going to turn up more and more. Satan is mad as hell because he knows he has a short time. We have to come out of these traditions and customs we learned in America and be new in Christ.

sense.text:
“Remember these, O Jacob and Israel”. Why did he have to tell us to remember? Because we were going to forget in this place, in this captivity, in our affliction. So he tells us: remember.

“For thou art my servant: I have formed thee”. He formed us, and we are his servants. “O Israel, thou shalt not be forgotten of me.” We will not be forgotten of God if we are walking right and living right in his sight. If you are living like the Pharisees and scribes, you will be forgotten; if you are living a righteous lifestyle, you will not.

“I have blotted out, as a thick cloud, thy transgressions, and, as a cloud, thy sins: return unto me; for I have redeemed thee.” What do we have to do? Return unto him. We have to return to our Lord, because he has redeemed us.

precepts.why:
He said he has redeemed us. “Wherefore come out from among them, and be ye separate, saith the Lord”. We have to come out from among them and separate from America, from everything we learned here, and leave it alone. Not as individuals, but as a nation.

“And touch not the unclean thing”: do not touch these fake holidays, do not touch unclean food, do not touch anything unclean in the sight of God if you want him to heal you.

“and I will receive you, And will be a Father unto you, and ye shall be my sons and daughters, saith the Lord Almighty.” We will be his sons and daughters once we come out of this place and leave it alone.

America has us under a delusion; America has us hypnotized with their lies. Everybody in every country wants to come to America, but they do not know we are oppressed here. They are living better than we are. Out in Africa, the South Pacific and South America you do not need a credit score; come to America and you need a credit score to get an apartment, a car, everything.

sense.text: “Remember ye the law of Moses my servant, which I commanded unto him in Horeb for all Israel, with the statutes and judgments.” He is telling us again: remember, remember, remember. We were going to forget his statutes and judgments. We have to come back and remember who we are in these last days.

“Behold, I will send you Elijah the prophet before the coming of the great and dreadful day of the Lord: And he shall turn the heart of the fathers to the children, and the heart of the children to their fathers”. He is going to turn us back to who we are. We might not remember exactly who we are, but we are damn sure going to remember what we are supposed to be doing, how we are supposed to be living, and the laws we are supposed to uphold in these last days. How are you reading the Bible and not keeping the laws? The laws are all through the whole Bible.

He is going to turn the hearts of the fathers to the children and the hearts of the children back to the fathers, because we are the fathers. When we read this Bible we are reading about ourselves: we are the Israelites from back then, the good, the bad and the ugly.

“Lest I come and smite the earth with a curse.” We have to come out of this place, remember who we are, and return back to the Lord. America has us hypnotized: social media, television and the movies are leading us. Everything here has been fake, an illusion of delusion.

precepts.why:
“The thing that hath been, it is that which shall be; and that which is done is that which shall be done”: what goes around comes around, like a ring, a circle. “And there is no new thing under the sun.”

“Is there any thing whereof it may be said, See, this is new? it hath been already of old time, which was before us.” That is the turning of the hearts of the fathers to the children and the children to the fathers. It is nothing new; we have all been here, going in this circle. This is not the first time it is happening; it is happening all over again.

“There is no remembrance of former things”. We do not remember the things that happened before, and that is why he tells us now to remember, because he knew we would forget. So we come back now and remember our job and our duty: serving the Lord, being righteous servants who uphold the Lord's statutes and commandments that God preserved and gave back to us in these last days. “Neither shall there be any remembrance of things that are to come with those that shall come after.” We constantly come back to this earth, uphold these laws and commandments, teach them, and wake our people up until Christ's return. That is why the hearts of the children are turned to the fathers and the hearts of the fathers to the children: we are the fathers, and we are those children today.

If you remember nothing else, remember that you are an Israelite, that you have to have faith in Christ, and that you have to keep the law and commandments to get salvation and be redeemed in the last days.

sense.text:
“I will go and return to my place, till they acknowledge their offence”: till the Israelites acknowledge our offence. Acknowledge that we have been breaking his law and commandments, that we have been sinning and going off, and that there is no way out of this but through the Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ, the King of kings and Lord of lords. We have to acknowledge what we did wrong and start getting it right.

“And seek my face”: we seek his face in the Bible.

“In their affliction they will seek me early.” That is the point: you Israelites are being afflicted right now to bring you back to the Father. Our brothers and sisters are getting shot down and hung in trees, a man shot in the head in the middle of the street for resisting a little with the police. The Most High is showing us these things so we get ourselves together. We are here today and gone tomorrow, so make sure you are living a righteous lifestyle and are in the right spirit, so you can stand before God with a clean conscience. Repent right now and make your way back to the heavenly Father before it is too late. In our affliction we are going to chase him down, calling him, crying and praying to him more and more.

precepts.why: “Come, and let us return unto the Lord: for he hath torn, and he will heal us; he hath smitten, and he will bind us up.” We have to come and return to the Lord. He tore us, he smote us, he beat us, he punished us, but he is going to bind us back up and heal us. He is going to fix us back to the righteous and great people we always were in the past. We are going to come back to that righteous nation again.

sense.text:
“That now it is high time to awake out of sleep”: brothers and sisters, it is high time to awake out of this deep sleep, this hypnosis that America has put on us.

“For now is our salvation nearer than when we believed.” We are in the last days. Christ is on his way back. Wars and rumors of wars are popping off all over the world; we are knocking on the door right now.

“The night is far spent, the day is at hand: let us therefore cast off the works of darkness”: let us cast off sin, the works of darkness. “And let us put on the armour of light.” We have to put on this Bible, living it day in and day out and keeping the Lord God's commandments. Everything goes back to keeping the law and commandments and the faith of Christ, and I don't give a damn what anybody says, this foolishness they are running around talking about.

“Nevertheless I have somewhat against thee, because thou hast left thy first love.” We have left our first love: keeping the law and commandments and the faith of Christ, glorifying the Lord in our bodies, doing the work day in and day out.

“Remember therefore from whence thou art fallen, and repent, and do the first works”. We have to remember where we fell from and repent. “Or else I will come unto thee quickly, and will remove thy candlestick out of his place”. If we do not repent he is going to remove our candlestick: he is going to take this spirit away from you.

We have to come out of this hypnosis we have been in too long in America, thinking we can get away with things and God is not paying attention, thinking we can say whatever and not be held accountable. For every idle word a man will be justified or condemned in the eyes of the Lord.

“Therefore I will judge you, O house of Israel, every one according to his ways, saith the Lord God.” The brothers at the discussion say they know they are Israel, but they do not realize that judgment comes to the house of Israel first. That is why they had better clean themselves up and get their act together.

“Repent, and turn yourselves from all your transgressions; so iniquity shall not be your ruin.” He says it again: repent, turn from your transgressions, and come back and serve him in righteousness, so your sin will not be your ruin.

“Cast away from you all your transgressions, whereby ye have transgressed; and make you a new heart and a new spirit”: a new heart, a new mind, a new spirit in you.

“For why will ye die, O house of Israel?” Why die stuck in foolishness, stuck in theology? Why die committing sins against our brothers and sisters, selling drugs to your people, getting shot down for foolishness, when you could live for something righteous and have a glorious end?

“For I have no pleasure in the death of him that dieth, saith the Lord God: wherefore turn yourselves, and live ye.” Turn to the Lord so you can have life instead of dying for nothing. We are all going to die, but at least die for your people, for your nation, not over a cell phone or an argument. Most of the evil we do is against each other, while every nation is looking to hurt us. We have to cast those things away, return to the Lord, and wake up out of this damn deep sleep, this coma America put us in, and serve the Lord in righteousness.

“Remember not the iniquities of our forefathers: but think upon thy power and thy name now at this time.” Think upon your power and your name, Father, and forget the iniquities we committed back then that brought us into the low state we are in now, breaking your law and commandments.

“For thou art the Lord our God, and thee, O Lord, will we praise. And for this cause thou hast put thy fear in our hearts”. He put his fear in our hearts because we know judgment comes every time we break his law.

“To the intent that we should call upon thy name, and praise thee in our captivity”. We have to call upon the name of the Lord, make our prayers and supplications like we are supposed to, and return back to the Father in righteousness.

“For we have called to mind all the iniquity of our forefathers, that sinned before thee.” We call to mind the iniquities our forefathers did, because we are the forefathers.

“Behold, we are yet this day in our captivity, where thou hast scattered us, for a reproach and a curse, and to be subject to payments, according to all the iniquities of our fathers, which departed from the Lord our God.” We are yet this day in our captivity. That is why we are subject to payments: you get paid, taxed; you buy something, taxed; you cash your check, more tax, tax on top of tax. They are taxing us crazy here because we broke God's law and commandments.

“God be gracious unto you, and remember his covenant that he made with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, his faithful servants”. That is why we are not consumed: he remembers the agreement he made with us way back then.

“And give you all an heart to serve him, and to do his will”. If you want to return and repent, he will give you a heart to serve him and to do his will, to keep his law, statutes and commandments.

“With a good courage and a willing mind”. We have to have a willing mind to serve the Lord, come with a sincere heart, be loyal in serving him, and come out of all this wickedness we learned here in America.

“And open your hearts in his law and commandments, and send you peace”. We have to open our minds back to his laws and commandments; that is why we have to return, wake up, and keep them. You wonder why you have no peace in your life, why you are all over the place? Because you are not serving him, not keeping his law and commandments in sincerity.

“And hear your prayers, and be at one with you, and never forsake you in time of trouble.” He will hear your prayers, and you will be at one with him. He will never forsake you in the time of trouble if you are sincere and honest with him, walking right in his sight, waking up and returning to him in sincerity. He will hear your cries and prayers, be peace to you, and help you through your hard times.
“And now we be here praying for you.” Repent, wake up, come out of this hypnosis we have been in in America, and start serving the Lord in righteousness.

precepts.why:
“For though I preach the gospel, I have nothing to glory of”: we have nothing to glory of, because all the glory goes back to the Father. That is what Paul was saying.

“For necessity is laid upon me”: necessity is laid upon each and every one of us to go out there and wake our people up, so they can repent, come out of it, and cast away their iniquities. “Yea, woe is unto me, if I preach not the gospel!” Woe unto us if we go out and preach not the gospel.

“For if I do this thing willingly, I have a reward”. We have to do this willingly; nobody can force you. You have a reward: a crown, everlasting life, immortality.

“But if against my will, a dispensation of the gospel is committed unto me.” If you do it against your will, he is going to take his spirit from you, and you will find yourself back outside those doors in the midst of wickedness and evil again. That is the willing mind of 2 Maccabees 1:3.

This is how you would not be at one with God. “Behold, the Lord's hand is not shortened, that it cannot save; neither his ear heavy, that it cannot hear”. His hand is not too short to reach down and help you when you are afflicted or in trouble, and his ear is not too heavy to hear your prayers and your cries.

“But your iniquities have separated between you and your God, and your sins have hid his face from you, that he will not hear.” That is what separates you from your God: your sins, your iniquities. That is the only way he separates himself from you, if you are in the midst of sin. But if you are doing what you are supposed to do, keeping the law and commandments and the faith of Christ, he is going to come to you, send you peace, and hear your prayers.
